title: BJ Brewhouse barbecue chicken salad
ingredients: 1lb Chicken with shawarma seasoning and onion finely diced plus egg and panko, mint, and 1/2 tsp salt
Make with hummus, pita, jalapenos, goat cheese or feta, tzatziki thin sliced onion, cucumber ,tomato
